title: Lakeflow Jobs and task dependencies
summary: Model production workflows as explicit tasks with inputs, dependencies, retries and observable outputs.

blocks.text: Model production workflows as explicit tasks with inputs, dependencies, retries and observable outputs.

items: Keep task boundaries meaningful enough to retry independently.
Pass small parameters/metadata between tasks instead of large in-memory objects.
Use cluster/serverless policies appropriate to workload and cost.
Attach alerts and inspect run history instead of relying on notebook UI state.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
